{{Quote|Clan Ordo's been hired to kill a Senator who's hiding out under major Jedi protection. It'll be a serious engagement. He's gone to ground in a heavily fortified area. Worth a lot of credits, too.|Corridan Ordo|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] '''senator''' took refuge on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Clan Ordo]] was hired to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the [[Senator/Legends|senator]], who had holed up in a heavily-fortified area with [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] protection; Clan Ordo met up at the [[House Baliss (estate)|House Baliss estate]] on Alderaan before going after the senator.
